scrape_yml:
global:
  scrape_interval: "15s"
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: "sa-home-nodes"
    metrics_path: "/metrics"
    file_sd_configs:
      - files: ["/var/lib/metrics-hub/targets/nodes.json"]
  - job_name: "sa-home-extra"
    metrics_path: "/metrics"
    file_sd_configs:
      - files: ["/var/lib/metrics-hub/targets/extra.json"]
